acme_prod_pm: Hey team — starting around 10:45 UTC we're seeing a burst of 5xx errors from the hosted API for our bulk ingest jobs. Mostly 504 and a few 502s. Our client retries which is causing duplicate billable tokens. We can reliably repro by running 200 parallel requests with batch_size=16. sample request id: req_4f9b1c. Any guidance?

ava_support: Sorry about that — can you share SDK version, region, and a minimal repro curl? Also any request ids or logs you can paste help. :sorry:

acme_prod_pm: SDK: node 1.8.2, region us-west1. repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-34b","prompt":"x","max_tokens":512,"batch_size":16}'
```
Log snippet (truncated):
```
[2026-02-14T10:46:12Z] req=req_4f9b1c status=504 upstream_read_timeout route=/v1/generate
[2026-02-14T10:46:12Z] req=req_4f9b1d status=502 connection_reset_by_peer
```

sam_engineer: ping @maria_sre @leo_infra — seems like a client-side herd + gateway queue issue. acme, did you see any p95 latency increase before the errors?

acme_prod_pm: yes p95 climbed from ~120ms to ~800ms prior to failures. We also noticed duplicate billing for some requests that later succeeded.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood/edge-proxy@v2.14.0 rolled to us-west1 at 2026-02-14T09:52:10Z.

leo_infra: Looking at edge metrics: tenant acme-prod showed inflight connection count spike to >1200 on the us-west1 edge pair. Per-route worker pool hit saturation and we saw connection queuing. That matches the 504s.

maria_sre: Temporary mitigations in progress: 1) ask customer to reduce client concurrency to avoid herd; 2) we're increasing edge worker count for us-west1 and adjusting LB drain timeout; rollout ETA ~10m. Also enable a short-term per-tenant concurrency cap at the gateway as a circuit breaker.

ava_support: Acme — can you try reducing SDK concurrency to 4 and add exponential backoff with jitter while we apply the infra changes? Quick command for node SDK: `client.setOptions({maxConcurrency: 4})`.

acme_prod_pm: Applying now... switching to maxConcurrency=4 and backing off on retries.

acme_prod_pm: Update — after reducing concurrency failures dropped from ~12% to ~1% and duplicate billing stopped. Thanks. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: Preliminary root cause (WIP): large client-side batching + many parallel requests produced long-tail KV-cache misses in the runtime, which spiked CPU on a subset of model workers. That amplified latency and caused gateway queue growth. Combined with current per-route worker settings, we hit timeouts.

leo_infra: Filed INF-2026-421 to track infra fixes: (a) enforce per-tenant in-flight caps at gateway, (b) rotate worker pool scaling policy to be more aggressive on CPU spikes, (c) add connection-queue length alerting. Hotfix rolling now; will confirm when fully applied.

maria_sre: We'll follow up with a short postmortem and recommended SDK best-practices for bulk ingest (smaller batch sizes, concurrency knobs, backoff).

ava_support: Draft customer note shared: "Action taken: reduced concurrency, increased edge workers, applied temporary per-tenant cap. Outcome: error rate dropped to ~1%. Next: infra hotfix, postmortem and SDK guidance. ETA for full mitigation: 2 hours." Want me to send?

acme_prod_pm: Yes please send that note to our team. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

leo_infra: Hotfix applied to us-west1 edge pair; connection queue length back to normal and no further 5xx spikes observed in the last 8 minutes. We'll monitor for 1h and then start the postmortem.

ava_support: Marking this thread as triaged. We'll reopen if we see regressions. Follow-up postmortem link (when ready) will be posted here. Thanks everyone.
